javax.accessibility.Accessible, java.awt.image.ImageObserver, MDCCaretChangeListener, MDCModelEditionListener, java.awt.MenuContainer, java.io.Serializable
public class JMDCEditor
extends javax.swing.JPanel

An editor for Manuel de codage text. If you want to manipulate the text, you may do it through the workflow object.
